name: Union Max
source:
Union Max is a Gay Adult / Yaoi Visual Novel that features the adventures of Max, the unlikely hero chosen to become the next ‘Light of the Kosmos!'

Max has been chosen by The Voice, an otherworldly entity, to travel across the various Realms of the Kosmos, seeking out the scattered sparks that make up the Light! 

Travel across the Realms of Angst, Desire, Romance and Happiness, meet those who carry the sparks, form bonds with them, and save the Kosmos! 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4602410/Union_Max/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Union Max》是一部同性恋成人/Yaoi视觉小说，以麦克斯的冒险为特色，麦克斯是一个不太可能的英雄，被选为下一个“宇宙之光！”

麦克斯被超凡脱俗的实体“声音”选中，穿越宇宙的各个领域，寻找构成光的分散火花！

穿越焦虑、欲望、浪漫和幸福的国度，遇见那些带着火花的人，与他们结下不解之缘，拯救宇宙！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4602410/Union_Max/]Steam[/url]]
